reviews.title: Makes Meal Planning So Much Easier
reviews.text: I’ve been looking for something to make meal planning easier, and this app has been really helpful. I love being able to plan out my meals and have everything organized in one place. Makes grocery shopping and figuring out what to eat for the week so much easier!

reviews.title: Bad Keto options
reviews.text: This is great in theory, but I was only given 4 keto meal options on repeat. I tried to remove the keto preference and just go low carb thinking maybe I could get some dishes with rice on the side I could just not eat, but every meal was still pasta, or breadcrumbs, or mashed potatoes. It didn’t feel low carb at all and I just wasn’t thrilled with the lack of variety. I would love this but it’s just not going to work for my dietary restrictions. I also wish there were ways to rank preferences and foods. I don’t mind fish but I really don’t want it often, for example. A pasta dish once in a while would probably be fine but not every week multiple times. Plus, it assumed I had pantry staples that I don’t and I wouldn’t loved to go through a list and uncheck and check things so it could add them to the grocery list. That didn’t appear to work when I tried.

reviews.title: Update
reviews.text: Size fixed. Thank you for getting back to me. The other complaint I have is when it ask for thing you can’t eat or don’t like. Like I am allergic to shrimp and olives because t for some reason most of the meals it sent I am allergic too. So I had to go get n and change them. I was meet the other impression that it created based upon n what you liked and could it. So I gave it 4 stars.

reviews.title: Extremely glitchy AI slop
reviews.text: The recipes and photography are clearly made with AI and leave out important pieces of information in the instructions. The ingredient pricing does not match actual store pricing. Some weeks the shopping list does not match the chosen recipes and leads you to purchase items you don’t need. It’s also too easy to swap a meal mid-week without being able to recover the meal you chose (and shopped for.) good idea with very poor execution that needs much more work to be worth the pricing, not to mention actual human testing and QA to ensure it’s working as intended.

reviews.title: Busy mom approved
reviews.text: As a super busy mom who loves to feed my family healthy but quick meals this app has been everything I was missing. It's so easy to set up, the budget tool is chefs kiss, and being able to either remove and ingredient that I don't like or swap a meal that just doesn't do it for me is amazing !

reviews.title: Life saver !
reviews.text: This app has been so great at meal planning, such a relief not to have to plan every meal anymore. It plans everything even makes a tailored grocery list within our budget and with stuff from our preferred stores and with our food preferences in mind ! SO helpful 🙌

reviews.title: Gold Star as a busy mom of 3
reviews.text: Has made my life so much easier as a busy Mom of three. I used to dread having to decide what to cook for supper and now I can literally get it done in like five minutes and not have to take time to try and find recipes!

reviews.title: No free version
reviews.text: In the description the developers state that there is a free version as well as a premium subscription. What they fail to tell you is that there is no way around the payment screen and you are REQUIRED to go through the trial period which means agreeing to the subscription and being signed up for automatic billing. If you advertise a free version, there should be a way to access such without having to give access to your card/apple/google/android wallet.

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text: I always struggle with trying to figure out what to make for my family every night. This takes the guesswork out of it and has stopped my extra spending at the grocery store.

reviews.title: Shopping budget is misleading
reviews.text: The shopping budget is misleading because it gives you a cost proportional to the amount used for that recipe. So if you only use 1 tablespoon of salsa, it’s only gonna show the price for that tablespoon of salsa—not the whole jar that you are having to buy. If you only need three scallions, it’ll only show you the price for three individual scallions, not the price to buy the package of eight scallions from which you will have to take the three.
